AMPLIFYING INFORMATION:

•	USCG SECTOR OHIO VALLEY INITIATED A CRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATIONS (CIC) CONFERENCE CALL TO REPORT THAT THE U.S.-FLAGGED INSPECTED TOWING VESSEL (ITV) HEAVY LANE, WITH SEVEN BARGES UNDER TOW, LOST STEERING IN THE VICINITY OF MILE MARKER 36 ON THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER NEAR CAIRO, ILLINOIS.
•	AS A RESULT, ITV HEAVY LANE MADE CONTACT WITH THE DESCENDING BANK, CAUSING FIVE OF THE SEVEN BARGES TO BREAK LOOSE.
•	OUT OF THE FIVE LOOSE BARGES, THREE ARE CARRYING HAZARDOUS MATERIALS: ONE IS LOADED WITH 346,000 GALLONS OF NAPHTHA, ANOTHER WITH 353,000 GALLONS OF LUBRICANT OIL, AND THE THIRD WITH 1.05 MILLION GALLONS OF PALM OIL.
•	ITV HEAVY LANE WAS ABLE TO MAINTAIN ITS POSITION, AND THE FIVE LOOSE BARGES ARE CURRENTLY GROUNDED ON A ROCK DIKE.
•	THERE ARE NO REPORTS OF POLLUTION OR INJURIES.
•	THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY, CANAL BARGE COMPANY, IS RESPONDING WITH ASSIST TUGS, WHICH HAVE AN ESTIMATED TIME OF ARRIVAL OF 45 MINUTES.
•	THERE ARE NO REPORTED IMPACTS TO THE MARITIME TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM.
•	THE CIC PROCESS WAS STOOD DOWN WITH THE CONCURRENCE OF BOTH USCG AREA COMMANDS.
•	THE USCG NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR THE SITUATION AND WILL ISSUE A FINAL UPDATE VIA EMAIL ONCE SALVAGE OPERATIONS ARE CONCLUDED OR STABILIZED UNDER CONTROL.

OVERVIEW: ORANGE COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT (OCFD) REPORTS A LARGE EVACUATION ORDER FOR SEVERAL BLOCKS IN GARDEN GROVE, CA (POP. 172K) HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED DUE TO A HAZARDOUS MATERIALS INCIDENT. THERE ARE NO REPORTED INJURIES OR FATALITIES.

SUMMARY: 

•	ON MAY 21, OCFD RESPONDED TO REPORTS OF A HAZARDOUS CHEMICAL INCIDENT AT AN AEROSPACE COMPANY. 
O	UPON ARRIVING THEY FOUND A 34K GALLON TANK CONTAINING METHYL METHACRYLATE, A VOLATILE LIQUID USED TO MAKE PLASTIC, WAS RELEASING GAS. 
O	FIREFIGHTERS CONDUCTED A SUCCESSFUL OPERATION TO COOL THE CHEMICAL BUT WERE UNABLE TO COMPLETE MITIGATION OF THE SITUATION DUE TO AN INOPERABLE VALVE ON THE TANK. 
O	AUTHORITIES ARE WORKING WITH THE MANUFACTURER, A THIRD-PARTY CONTRACTOR, AND HAZARDOUS MATERIALS TEAMS TO MITIGATE THE SITUATION. 
•	THERE IS NO ACTIVE LEAK OR PLUME.
•	THE TANK IS UNABLE TO BE SECURED OR MITIGATED.
O	AUTHORITIES REPORT THAT THE TANK COULD FAIL AND SPILL OR EXPLODE.
•	IT IS UNCLEAR WHAT CAUSED THE TANK FAILURE. 

ACTIONS: 

•	FEMA REPORTS APPROXIMATELY 10,311 PEOPLE ARE UNDER A MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER.  
•	THERE ARE TWO EVACUATION CENTERS WITH AN UNKNOWN NUMBER OF OCCUPANTS. 
•	THE ORANGE COUNTY EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER HAS BEEN ACTIVATED.
claude_summary: A failing 34,000-gallon tank of methyl methacrylate at an aerospace company in Garden Grove, CA, put roughly 10,300 people under mandatory evacuation orders after firefighters were unable to secure an inoperable valve. Authorities warned the tank could still fail, spill or explode.

OVERVIEW: THE SANDY FIRE IN VENTURA COUNTY, CA HAS GROWN RAPIDLY SINCE IT SPARKED YESTERDAY. THE FIRE HAS SPREAD TO OVER 1.3K ACRES, WITH OVER 41K EVACUATIONS AND IS AT ZERO PERCENT CONTAINMENT. SUPPRESSION EFFORTS CONTINUE PRIORITIZING THE PROTECTION OF THREATENED COMMUNITIES. CALMER WINDS AND INCREASED HUMIDITY ARE FORECASTED, WHICH WILL SUPPORT FIRE-FIGHTING EFFORTS. AN FMAG WAS APPROVED ON MAY 18.
FIRE STATISTICS
•	THE SANDY FIRE IGNITED JUST AFTER 1300 ET ON MAY 18 NEAR SANDY AVENUE IN VENTURA COUNTY.
•	OVER 1,364 ACRES HAVE BURNED.
•	SEVERAL COMMUNITIES IN SIMI VALLEY ARE THREATENED.
•	MORE THAN 10K HOMES HAVE BEEN EVACUATED.
•	AN ADDITIONAL 3.5K HOMES ARE UNDER EVACUATION WARNINGS.
•	FIRE ACTIVITY HAS DECREASED DUE TO CALMER WINDS AND HIGHER HUMIDITY.
•	THE CAUSE OF THE FIRE IS UNDER INVESTIGATION. 
FIRE FIGHTING EFFORTS
•	750 FIREFIGHTERS ARE CURRENTLY ASSIGNED TO THE INCIDENT.
•	CREWS ARE WORKING TO BUILD CONTAINMENT LINES AROUND THE FIRE.
•	NIGHT-FLYING HELICOPTERS ARE DROPPING WATER ON HOTSPOTS AND AREAS OF CONCERN TO PREVENT FLARE-UPS OVERNIGHT.
INFRASTRUCTURE AND HEALTH AND WELFARE IMPACTS
•	CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE AT RISK INCLUDES HIGHWAYS, POWER LINES, NATIONAL PARK SERVICE LAND, THE RONALD REAGAN PRESIDENTIAL LIBRARY, POLICE AND FIRE STATIONS. 
•	THE SIMI VALLEY UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT SCHOOLS ARE CLOSED TODAY.
•	EVACUATIONS ARE AFFECTING THOUSANDS OF RESIDENTS AND HOMES.
•	COMMUNITIES ARE URGED TO FOLLOW GUIDANCE FROM LOCAL OFFICIALS TO ENSURE SAFETY.
FEDERAL AND STATE RESPONSE
•	FEMA NWC IS MONITORING; FEMA REGION 9 AND REGIONAL RESPONSE COORDINATION CENTER ARE PERSONNEL MOBILIZATION CENTER (PMC) STAFFING.
•	THE GOVERNOR OF CA ANNOUNCED THE STATE HAS SECURED A FIRE MANAGEMENT ASSISTANCE GRANT (FMAG) FROM FEMA.
•	THE LOS ANGELES FIRE DEPARTMENT (LAPD) HAS PREPOSITIONED RESOURCES IN THE SAN FERNANDO VALLEY ASSISTING VENTURA COUNTY.
•	THERE ARE TWO EVACUATION SHELTERS FOR PEOPLE AND FOUR ANIMAL SHELTERS OPEN FOR SMALL AND LARGE ANIMAL.

•	THE INCIDENT WAS FIRST REPORTED BY THE FLORIDA AVENUE BRIDGE OPERATOR IN THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI RIVER.

•	THE CITY MAYOR HAS BEEN BRIEFED ON THE SITUATION BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE SEWAGE AND WATER BOARD.
•	DAMAGE ESTIMATES CURRENTLY RANGE FROM $2 MILLION TO $10 MILLION.
•	THE WATERWAY IS CLOSED FROM THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI RIVER ENTRANCE UP TO CHALMETTE LOWER ALGIERS.
•	ALL VESSELS ARE CURRENTLY BEING REDIRECTED TO ALTERNATE ROUTES TO BYPASS THE AFFECTED AREA.
•	A FOLLOW-ON CIC CALL IS SCHEDULED FOR SUNDAY, 19 APRIL AT 1500 EST.
